value.rationale: Schneider explicitly highlights the exact number of convexity points by noting triangles and Reuleaux triangles have precisely three and asks whether that behavior is typical; the later theorem shows Baire-typical bodies instead have infinitely many. Quadrilaterals are the first polygonal class beyond triangles. The theorem gives a complete exact classification on the canonical open dense no-parallel-side stratum, including explicit affine formulas, and shows that this entire low-complexity family still has the minimal possible count three. This is a natural structural boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
